items.text: The decision buttons are the crux of PRD-118 §3. Reject and Request-changes branch into the variants further right on this row.
First-run: one calm CTA, no stats. Resist adding onboarding chrome here until the submit flow is validated.
Upload is deliberately mocked — static first. Real file handling only if a scenario needs to demonstrate it.
Error copy agreed with support. Keep the retry; don't add a status page link yet.
Registered as its own component so the decision matrix can be signed off without the page around it. Same contract, smaller frame.
